about.title: About Us
about.description: Inversiones Tunki Chasky S.R.L. is a leading intercity passenger transport and parcel logistics company in the Cusco region. Operating modern 3-row vehicles, we deliver Formal, Safe, Reliable, and Punctual services for all travelers.

1.title: Machu Picchu Route
1.desc: Direct and fast connection for tourists and locals seeking punctuality to Hidroeléctrica.

2.title: La Convención Route
2.desc: Daily trips via the Málaga pass with experienced mountain drivers.

3.title: Quellouno Route
3.desc: Safe and quick transport connection to the Quellouno tropical valley every day.

4.title: Sacred Valley Route
4.desc: Frequent transport to the heart of Calca in modern vehicles.

5.title: Train Connection
5.desc: Arrive on time for your train to Machu Picchu with our executive service.

6.title: National Route
6.desc: Special service to the capital with GPS and 24/7 real-time monitoring.

7.title: Intercity Route
7.desc: The fastest and safest option for traveling to Abancay.

1.text: "Excellent service, very fast and the vehicles are very comfortable. 100% recommended."

comunicado.title: ANNOUNCEMENT
comunicado.subtitle: Dear users, before making your purchase, please keep the following in mind:
comunicado.item1: Ticket purchases must be made under the name of the person who will use the service.
comunicado.item2: Minors traveling without their parents must have the corresponding notarized travel authorization.
comunicado.item3: Traveling under the influence of alcohol or any illegal substance is strictly prohibited.
comunicado.footer: Please remember that your purchase is subject to the terms and conditions established by the company and published on this website.
